text:
mia: Massive thanks to @rahul and @tara for the late-night salvage operation — demo was green by 01:48am and they even brought coconut cookies. true heroes :cookie: :trophy:

rahul: found a bad nginx upstream in the load balancer config (`upstream app { server 10.0.0.7:8080; }`) pointing to an old instance. replaced and reloaded with `nginx -s reload`. smoke -> pass.

tara: muted noisy alerts, rolled a quick canary, and babysat the deploy. also left cookies in the kitchenette labeled "demo survivors". :yum:

ops-bot: Incident INC-5012 acknowledged at 2025-11-22T01:15Z. Assigned: infra-night.

culture-bot: Kudos posted: "Midnight magic: rahul + tara". Sticker awarded.

mia: adding to the kudos wall and to the retro note: "people, cookies, and quick config fixes saved the day" :sparkles:

rahul: team effort. also proposing a new oncall tradition: whoever fixes it picks the morning pastry. starting scoreboard. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

tara: i'll take credit and share the cookies. thanks everyone <3 :heart:
